assumptions: Date range inclusive of both endpoints: 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30
Revenue computed as sum(quantity * unit_price_cents) converted to USD by dividing by 100
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_cents) / 100.0, 0) AS total_usd,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE o.customer_region = 'APAC'
  AND o.status = 'closed'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01'
  AND o.order_date <= '2026-06-30'
